findings: Weil explicitly gives orthogonal-sum multiplicativity and eighth-root-valued quadratic indices. Their ratio for uQ0 and Q0 has two-power order. Combined with the retained common-cover cocycle, division gives the normalized honest unit action, preserving the distinction from the genuine order-four lift at minus identity.

For the given automorphic representation, rational central invariance and the stated holomorphic archimedean weight are incoming. The reference theta-cubed representation has the same infinity action. Weil II30 gives its rational index product relation; taking the quotient forces the finite character to be even. No B0-specific square determinant is assumed.
Waldspurger I3(5) gives c_p^0(u)=1 at valuations zero and one at odd unramified primes away from the character conductor. This includes squarefree D0 primes outside S0.

The proof of IV4 Lemma6 explicitly uses local Whittaker uniqueness to factor the global functional. With the separately retained nonzero D0 functional, replacing finitely many vectors by nonzero D0-local-functionals preserves the nonzero product. The note does not claim this for arbitrary nonzero local vectors.
